description: This file implements functionalities for handling GitHub packages within a package management system. It includes parsing GitHub URLs, downloading and extracting archives, validating package structure, and integrating installed packages into a registry. The core class is 'GitHubInstaller', which manages the installation process from GitHub repositories.

classes.name: GitHubPackageInfo
classes.description: Represents parsed components of a GitHub URL, including owner, repo, ref, full URL, and archive URL.

classes.name: GitHubInstaller
classes.description: Handles the installation of packages from GitHub repositories, including download, extraction, validation, and registry update.

methods.name: IsGitHubURL
methods.description: Checks if a string matches known GitHub URL patterns.

methods.name: ParseGitHubURL
methods.description: Parses a GitHub URL into its components, such as owner, repo, ref, and constructs archive URL.

methods.name: InstallFromGitHub
methods.description: Main method to install a package from a GitHub URL, managing download, validation, and registry update.

methods.name: downloadAndExtract
methods.description: Downloads and extracts the GitHub repository archive into a temporary directory.

methods.name: extractZip
methods.description: Extracts a zip archive into a specified directory.

methods.name: findPackageRoot
methods.description: Finds the root directory containing 'agentfield-package.yaml' within extracted contents.

methods.name: updateRegistryWithGitHub
methods.description: Updates the local installation registry with information about the installed package from GitHub.
